name: Belfry deck
notes: The deck of the belfry tower in the bellwater-priory scene (mw-e39.38). The player-filtered volume `belfry` is the main quest area `belfry`: entering it completes only visit-the-priory (the priory may be visited before Act II). The Act III climb objectives use the separate area `sounding-shaft-top` (arriving at the top by climbing the shaft from below), which is unwired until the shaft is built (mw-5wg). Reached by the interior stair, the south free-climb or the roped parapet; the Sounding Shaft climb from below is mw-e26.18.
